history.administration_response: The sampled projects subject to this recommendation had already been audited by project auditors in 2021. Ineligible expenditure identified was submitted to the implementing partners for refunds. However, the administrators of country- based pooled funds will ensure that no similar discrepancies occur moving forward. With this update, it is requested that the recommendation be closed.
